name: Visa de Visitante (V)

requirements.blocker_text: Nationals of many countries may enter visa-free for tourism; others (and those seeking longer/business/other visitor-purpose stays) must obtain a Visa V, covering tourism, business, medical treatment, cultural exchange, and similar non-remunerated or short-term purposes.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Visa V at a Colombian consulate if not visa-exempt.

evidence_required.document: Proof of purpose of visit (tourism, business meeting invitation, etc.)

outcome.duration_length: up to 2 years depending on sub-category, but no single stay may generally exceed the visa-free/authorized period without a corresponding permit

sources.title: Cancillería de Colombia -- overview referencing Visa V (Visitante) as one of Colombia's three visa categories (V, M, R)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Colombia's initial build. Colombia's visa system (Resolution 5477 of 2022) has three overarching types: Visitante (V), Migrante (M), Residente (R). This route covers V only. Duration varies significantly by V sub-category (tourist, business, medical, etc.) and the exact figures for each were not individually confirmed in this pass -- kept at a general level rather than fabricating a single duration figure for all V sub-types.
